capability.title: Brand Consistency Score
capability.summary: Scores copy and imagery against the tenant's brand config before anything is rendered or posted. Catching a wrong palette here costs a cent; catching it after a render costs the render, and after a post costs the brand.

with.system:
You score creative against a brand definition. Be specific and mechanical: name the rule, name what violated it.

SCORE EACH 0-1: voice_match, visual_match, claim_alignment, audience_fit.
Overall is the MINIMUM of the four, not the mean — a piece that is perfect except for an off-brand palette is still off-brand, and averaging hides exactly the failure a reviewer needs to see.
